s1.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory distress with pleuritic chest pain and hypoxia in a patient with a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Pulmonary embolism in the right pulmonary artery and left segmental artery embolus
key_facts: Medical history of ovarian serous carcinoma
Recurrent refractory disease on salvage chemotherapy
Presented with dyspnea and cough for 1 day
Required non-rebreather mask to maintain O2 saturation of 90%
Pulmonary embolism in the right pulmonary artery and left segmental artery embolus
Pleural fluid analysis: Exudate with malignant cells

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory distress with pleuritic chest pain and hypoxia in a patient with a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Pulmonary embolism in the right pulmonary artery and left segmental artery embolus
key_facts: Medical history of ovarian serous carcinoma
Recurrent refractory disease on salvage chemotherapy
Presented with dyspnea and cough for 1 day
Required non-rebreather mask to maintain O2 saturation of 90%
Pulmonary embolism in the right pulmonary artery and left segmental artery embolus
Pleural fluid analysis: Exudate with malignant cells

shortlist.label: Pulmonary embolism
shortlist.why_kept: Confirmed by CT angiography showing embolism in the right pulmonary artery and left segmental artery

shortlist.label: Malignant pleural effusion
shortlist.why_kept: Pleural fluid analysis showed exudate with malignant cells, consistent with metastatic ovarian cancer

shortlist.label: Metastatic ovarian cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's medical history and presence of malignant cells in pleural fluid support this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Pulmonary infarction
shortlist.why_kept: Possible complication of pulmonary embolism, given patient's symptoms and imaging findings

shortlist.label: Right heart strain
shortlist.why_kept: Evidence of right heart strain on initial CT angiography, consistent with pulmonary embolism and hypoxia

raw.rationale: Pleural fluid analysis showed exudate with malignant cells, consistent with the patient's history of ovarian serous carcinoma, and the presence of bilateral pleural effusions

rejected.label: Pulmonary embolism
rejected.why: Although present, it does not fully explain the malignant cells in the pleural fluid

rejected.label: Metastatic ovarian cancer
rejected.why: Too broad, as it encompasses multiple possible manifestations, including malignant pleural effusion

rejected.label: Pulmonary infarction
rejected.why: Not directly supported by the evidence, as high-sensitivity troponins were not elevated

rejected.label: Right heart strain
rejected.why: A consequence of the pulmonary embolism, but not the primary diagnosis explaining the malignant cells in the pleural fluid
